product: Logitech G keyboards (HID++ 2.0, cable or Lightspeed receiver)
works: written from Solaar (e7304c4c) and libratbag (8235b5bb) and checked against simulated keyboards only (tests/sim-logitech-keyboard.mjs)
feature lookup through Root getFeature (no fixed indexes); receivers: slots 1-6 pinged, a mouse (0x2201) is refused
report rate: 0x8061 or 0x8060, from the keyboard's own list (Solaar ExtendedReportRate / ReportRate), host mode only
settings source onboard / host: 0x8100 fn 0x20 / 0x10 (Solaar OnboardProfiles)
onboard profile select only: profile count from 0x8100 fn 0x00 byte 3 (libratbag), read fn 0x40, select fn 0x30 [sector] (Solaar OnboardProfiles); profiles are never edited
key locks, the Windows-key lock first: 0x4521 caps fn 0x00, read 0x10, write 0x20, the other bits sent back as read (Solaar DisableKeyboardKeys)
F-key swap: 0x40A2 or 0x40A0, read 0x00 / write 0x10 (Solaar NewFnSwap / FnSwap)
backlight brightness: 0x8040 info 0x00, read 0x10 / write 0x20, on/off 0x30 / 0x40, the keyboard's own steps when it has them (Solaar BrightnessControl)
every write read back; every write refused while G HUB (lghub*.exe) runs
doesNotWork: firmware updates, DFU, resets and pairing (never: Logitech's own app only)
editing onboard profiles (keys, macros, lights): profile memory writes rewrite flash and are never sent
lighting colours and effects (0x8071 / 0x8081 have no read-back)
G-key and M-key remaps, and a game mode beyond the key locks (no documented read-back)
PRO X TKL and G915 X (no product ids in any source read)
the K375s-style F-key swap 0x40A3 (needs the host-info feature; office keyboards)
the second G915 receiver C547: not claimed yet (tests/device-library.mjs uses it as an unclaimed receiver)
